Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a flat separate moving SHUTTER LAYER for a landscape Playdate main menu, exact 5:3 aspect, 1600x960 pixels if possible.
Draw ONLY the rectangular surface of a CLOSED metal roll-up shutter on a street-food burger truck, straight-on orthographic view. Horizontal metal slats run completely edge to edge with coarse black seam lines. Light white-painted metal with a few black chipped paint marks and sparse dither shading. No frame, no surrounding truck body, no wheels, no scenery, no perspective vanishing point: this entire image will translate upwards behind a fixed frame.
Center-lower area: a large abstract HAMBURGER GRAFFITI tag PAINTED FLAT ON the slats. Use a few broad expressive spray-paint black strokes to suggest an arched bun, seeds, a zigzag melting-cheese slice and two sweeping patty stripes, lower bun. It should feel like confident cheeky street art, not a detailed rendered floating food item; asymmetry, black drips, a few coarse stencil overspray dots and one short lightning stroke. Slat seams remain visible through/across the graffiti so it reads as paint on the shutter. No face, eyes, person or mascot.
Critical reserved space: the top 35% is only quiet light horizontal slats, no artwork or lettering, for an independently overlaid title. The bottom 15% is quiet light slats for a single independently rendered start hint. Burger graffiti mostly occupies middle 35%-80% height and middle 60% width.
Strictly black and white, coarse purposeful 1-bit ink/dither with the rough pixel edges seen in the reference game image. Hard white ground, no gradient, no smooth gray shading, no color, no glossy 3D. Legible reduced to 400x240. NO TEXT AT ALL, no BUN RUSH title, no start message, no buttons, no watermark. Flat full-bleed production art layer; do not show this as a screenshot mounted on a device.
The attached previous menu is a BLACK-AND-WHITE TEXTURE reference only; replace its food illustration, lettering, composition, and UI entirely with this flat graffiti shutter surface.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background layer revealed BEHIND a rising roller shutter, landscape 5:3, ideally 1600x960.
Draw a compact burger FOOD TRUCK INTERIOR seen straight ahead from its open service hatch, a shallow centered one-point perspective that allows a camera to push inward. Black and white coarse ink, 1-bit stipple and scratchy stencil textures matching the attached graffiti-shutter image; realistic kitchen equipment proportions with economical bold silhouettes. The shutter itself is ABSENT from this layer.
Composition: a broad light worktop across the lower third, a recognizable small manual meat grinder mounted on the left side of the worktop, a shallow rectangular griddle near center-right, a modest stack of buns at far right. Behind the counter a darker stippled kitchen back wall, a vent hood high center-right, a narrow shelf with just a few containers, and two blank order slips. Leave the center visually open as the destination for the push-in. No employees or people. Keep the environment sparse enough to read at 400x240 and avoid an over-detailed restaurant illustration.
The camera looks into the truck, not at its exterior; no wheels, no road, no buildings. No foreground closed door, no roll-up shutter, no title, no graffiti burger in this layer, no lettering, no menu controls, no logos. White highlights against stippled dark recesses, strictly black and white, no gradients, no gray washes, no smooth rendering. No border, device mockup or watermark. Full-bleed background art, all objects safely inside the image.

Use case: logo-brand
Create one clean standalone "BUN RUSH" wordmark, seven letters, ONE HORIZONTAL LINE. Wide 3:1 canvas. Bold condensed forward-slanted black street-stencil lettering with sparse coarse ink chips along trailing edges, same letter identity as the attached menu title. Large, complete, evenly spaced, legible. Place letters tightly in a horizontally centered block with only small margins.
BACKGROUND MUST BE PERFECTLY SOLID PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Do not represent transparency. No checkerboard pattern, no gray square pattern, no paper texture, no wall, no shutter, no background marks. Only black wordmark on immaculate white.
NO other image elements, no food, no menu choices, no instructions, no title outline, no icons or speed lines, no shadow, no gradient. All ink within the letters. This is a black-and-white title mask master for separate animation, not a composed menu.
